# World Animal Foundation

> Comprehensive animal education and pet care resource featuring wildlife encyclopedias, conservation information, dog breed guides, and interactive pet health tools.

World Animal Foundation (WAF) provides extensive educational content about animals across all species categories, from invertebrates to mammals, alongside practical pet ownership resources. The site specializes in dog-related content including breed guides, training materials, and reviews of GPS collar technology like Halo Collar and SpotOn systems.

## Key Topics

- Animal Encyclopedia
- Wildlife Education
- Pet Safety
- Dog Breeds
- Dog Training
- GPS Dog Fences
- Animal Behavior
- Animal Facts
- Wildlife Conservation
- Pet Care
- Halo Collar
- SpotOn GPS Dog Fence
- Dog Collars
- Endangered Species
- Marine Life

## Animal Encyclopedia & Wildlife

- [A-Z Animals - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/animals): Comprehensive A-Z animal encyclopedia with facts, behavior, and conservation info
- [Mammals - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/animals/mammals): Wildlife facts and endangered species info for mammals including tigers and whales
- [Birds - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/birds): Bird behavior, nesting, feeding habits, and wildlife education resource
- [Fish - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/fish): Marine life facts, ocean conservation, and fish species encyclopedia
- [Reptiles - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/animals/reptiles): Reptile species guide covering snakes, lizards, and pet care information
- [Invertebrates - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/animals/invertebrates): Educational guide to invertebrates, insects, and marine animals

## Dog Breeds & Selection

- [Dog Breeds - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dog-breeds): Comprehensive dog breed guide with characteristics and selection criteria
- [Dogs - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs): Dog breeds guide covering selection, companionship, and breed characteristics

## Dog Training & Behavior

- [Dog Training - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/dog-training): Dog training courses, techniques, and behavioral guidance for owners

## Dog Equipment & Safety

- [Dog Collars - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/collars): Dog collar reviews and GPS fence products for pet safety and containment
- [Dog Fences - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/fences): Dog fence options including GPS and invisible fences with product comparisons
- [Dog Harness - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/harness): Dog harness guide for safety, training, and pet equipment selection
- [Dog Leashes - WAF](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/leashes): Dog leash guide covering training, equipment, and care techniques

## GPS Dog Collar Reviews

- [Halo Collar 5 Review [I Tested It In March 2026]](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/halo-collar-review): Hands-on Halo Collar 5 review with GPS accuracy, safety, and training analysis
- [SpotOn GPS Dog Fence Review - Nova Edition Updated](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/spoton-dog-collar-review): SpotOn Nova Edition GPS dog fence review with features, pros, and cons
- [Halo Collar 3 Vs SpotOn GPS Fence - Which Dog Collar Wins?](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/spoton-vs-halo-dog-fence): Comparative review of SpotOn and Halo Collar GPS fence systems for dogs

## Pet Health Tools

- [Dog Age Calculator: How Old Is My Dog In Human Years?](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/age-calculator): Interactive tool to calculate dog age in human years by breed and size
- [Dog BMI Calculator - Helpful Tool For Dog's Optimal Health](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/bmi-calculator): Dog BMI calculator tool for weight management and optimal health assessment
- [Dog Chocolate Toxicity Calculator - How Much Chocolate Can Dog Eat?](https://worldanimalfoundation.org/dogs/chocolate-toxicity-calculator): Interactive toxicity calculator to assess chocolate dangers for dogs
